preamble: Lowering of the nasalized close vowel /ĩ/ to close-mid /ẽ/. In French it is the first step of the Modern French lowering chain /ĩ/ > /ẽ/ > /ɛ̃/ > [æ̃] (Quebec [ẽɪ̯̃]), which produced the open nasal vowel of vin, fin and juin. It reflects the general tendency of nasal vowels to lower.

examples.note: /ĩ/ lowered to /ẽ/ and then to /ɛ̃/; the same lowering affected the sequence /ỹĩ/ > /ɥĩ/ > /ɥɛ̃/ (juin < iūnium).

sources: Wikipedia (2026). Phonological history of French: Modern French period (/ĩ/ > /ẽ/ > /ɛ̃/). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phonological_history_of_French
